Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain cities from the national pollutant discharge elimination system municipal separate storm sewer systems permit program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain cities from the nationalpollutant discharge elimination system municipal separate storm sewersystems permit program; adding a new section to chapter 90.48 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that under the federalclean water act, and the department of ecology's delegation ofauthority to implement the federal clean water act as provided in RCW90.48.260, certain cities in Washington should not be required to becovered under the national pollutant discharge elimination systemmunicipal separate storm sewer systems (MS4) permit program. Certaincities within Washington have unique soils and topography that makesstorm water management in those areas extraordinarily challenging.Therefore, it is the intent of the legislature that these cities beexempt from the national pollutant discharge elimination systemmunicipal separate storm sewer systems permit program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Cities with a population between twentyfour thousand five hundredand twentyfive thousand, as reported in the 2000 census, and locatedin a county with a population between forty thousand five hundred andfortyone thousand five hundred, as reported in the 2000 census, eastof the crest of the Cascade mountains are exempt from the requirementto obtain a national pollutant discharge elimination system municipalseparate storm sewer systems (MS4) permit, as provided in RCW90.48.260.
